title: Llama holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M70 40 Q68 55 62 68' stroke='#c9a7ff' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='28' rx='12' ry='14' fill='#ff5c8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='23' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ff9db8'/>
  <path d='M70 42 l-3 4 h6 z' fill='#e04070'/>
  <!-- llama body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='66' rx='20' ry='13' fill='#f3e6ff'/>
  <!-- llama legs -->
  <rect x='27' y='74' width='6' height='18' rx='3' fill='#e3cdf7'/>
  <rect x='38' y='74' width='6' height='18' rx='3' fill='#f3e6ff'/>
  <rect x='49' y='74' width='6' height='18' rx='3' fill='#e3cdf7'/>
  <rect x='56' y='74' width='6' height='18' rx='3' fill='#f3e6ff'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='30' y='36' width='11' height='26' rx='5' fill='#f3e6ff'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='32' rx='15' ry='10' fill='#f3e6ff'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='21' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#e3cdf7'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='20' rx='3' ry='6' fill='#e3cdf7'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='34' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#ffe0f0'/>
  <ellipse cx='21' cy='33' rx='1.6' ry='1.2' fill='#b06fa0'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='30' r='2.4' fill='#5a2a7a'/>
  <circle cx='36.8' cy='29.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- fluffy tail -->
  <circle cx='62' cy='58' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
